name: CosmiVoice
summary: CosmiVoice is building AI voice employees that answer and make real business calls, understand what people need, and act on it: booking, updating, qualifying, routing and following up.

image.alt: A glowing profile of a woman wearing a headset, drawn in blue, violet and amber light

title: Your next employee
doesn't need a desk.
hero.lede: AI voice employees that answer and make your business calls in the language your customer speaks, then act on every one: booking, updating and following up while the caller is still on the line.
hero.note: Simulated conversations. CosmiVoice is in development and languages will roll out in stages.

lines.text: నాకు వచ్చే వారం అపాయింట్‌మెంట్ బుక్ చేయాలి.

Yes! Can I see it this weekend?

story.label: What an AI employee does
title: It doesn't just talk.
It gets the work done.
story.body: One call, from the first ring to the follow-up.

steps.title: The call comes in
steps.body: A customer calls at 9:47 pm, long after the front desk has gone home. CosmiVoice answers on the first ring.

steps.title: It understands
steps.body: Speech turns into meaning in real time: what they want, how they feel and how urgent it is.

console.transcript: My tooth has been aching since last night. Can I come in soon?

steps.title: It thinks
steps.body: Before it answers, it pulls the customer's history, your policies and the live calendar.

cards: Returning patient since 2023 · last visit in March · prefers evenings
Same-day slots are held for pain and emergencies
Dr. Rao · free at 4:30 PM and 6:15 PM today

steps.title: It acts
steps.body: It books, updates, qualifies or transfers. Real actions in your systems, not just words.

items: Visit reason and pain level recorded
Front desk notified of a same-day patient

steps.title: It follows up
steps.body: When the call ends, the summary, the next step and the WhatsApp message are already done.

console.summary: Priya Nair called about tooth pain since last night. Booked with Dr. Rao today at 4:30 PM. Reminded to bring her last X-ray.
console.message: Hi Priya, you're booked with Dr. Rao today at 4:30 PM at SmileCare, Indiranagar. Reply R to reschedule.
